name: N8N-PUPPETEER
description: Deploy n8n with Puppeteer browser automation and PostgreSQL on Railway.

PORT.description: Port used by the n8n web server.

NODES_EXCLUDE.description: Comma-separated list of n8n nodes to disable.

DB_POSTGRESDB_HOST.description: Hostname of the PostgreSQL database service.

DB_POSTGRESDB_PORT.description: Port of the PostgreSQL database service.

DB_POSTGRESDB_DATABASE.description: PostgreSQL database name used by n8n.

DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD.description: Password for the PostgreSQL database user.

N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED.description: Enable task runners for scalable workflow execution.

PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH.description: Path to the Chromium or Chrome executable.

N8N_VERSION_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED.description: Enable notifications for new n8n versions.

N8N_ENFORCE_SETTINGS_FILE_PERMISSIONS.description: Enforce secure permissions for n8n settings files.

PGDATA.description: Directory where PostgreSQL stores database files.

PGHOST.description: Hostname used to connect to PostgreSQL.

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Number of days generated SSL certificates remain valid.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Grace period before shutting down old deployments.
